rituals.Hook: When fear is making a possibility feel like a certainty, try The Odds Receipt. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.Mission: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
rituals.Game Move: Give yourself one clean run: Score Odds first, Follow Evidence last.
rituals.How to Play:
🎮 THE ODDS RECEIPT // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Score Odds — Give the prediction a number from 0 to 100.
2. Check Baseline — Find one relevant base rate: how often has this happened in similar situations?
3. Weigh Evidence — Notice one fact that raises the odds and another that lowers them.
4. Revise Odds — Issue a revised number and date it.
5. Follow Evidence — Act from the revision, not the original alarm.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Follow Evidence, you are done.
rituals.POWER-UP 1: When you arrive at Score Odds, press both feet down for three seconds.
rituals.POWER-UP 2: At Weigh Evidence, ask what a neutral camera could actually record.
rituals.POWER-UP 3: When you reach Follow Evidence, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
rituals.Win / Reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Follow Evidence feels more deliberate than automatic.

📸 MY RESULT
“Fear gave me certainty. Evidence gave me odds.”
rituals.Formula Flow: Score Odds → Check Baseline → Weigh Evidence → Revise Odds → Follow Evidence
rituals.Safety:
PAUSE
End the count if numbers become reassurance checking or you cannot stop recalculating.

rituals.Ritual Title: CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE
rituals.Hook: When your mind keeps delaying the first move, try Change The Mental Tool, Not The Pressure. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.
rituals.Mission: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
rituals.Game Move: Touch Decide Accept, follow the moves, and finish on Choose Shut.
rituals.How to Play:
🎮 CHANGE THE MENTAL TOOL, NOT THE PRESSURE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Decide Accept — Classify the demand as SOLVE, DECIDE, FEEL, ACCEPT, COMMUNICATE, or WAIT.
2. Name Mode — Name the mode currently running.
3. Choose Shut — Shut it down and perform the first action belonging to the correct mode—calculate, choose, allow, release, speak, or schedule.

⚡ DONE — Complete Choose Shut, then return to your day.
rituals.POWER-UP 1: At the start of Decide Accept, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
rituals.POWER-UP 2: At Name Mode, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
rituals.POWER-UP 3: When you reach Choose Shut, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
rituals.Win / Reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The exercise gives you enough room to make Choose Shut intentional.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”
rituals.Formula Flow: Decide Accept → Name Mode → Choose Shut
rituals.Safety:
PAUSE
Mixed situations may need modes in sequence rather than one Name.

rituals.Hook: When you have fallen inside the thought instead of noticing it, Demote The Headline Experience gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
rituals.Mission: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.Game Move: Move through the sequence once, from Hold Sensation to Focus.
rituals.How to Play:
🎮 DEMOTE THE HEADLINE EXPERIENCE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Hold Sensation — Hold the dominant sensation or thought with three background what you notices—one sound, one contact point, one visual feature.
2. Give Attention — For a contained interval, give all four equal attentional weight without imagining a separate watcher.
3. Focus — Notice how centrality changes.

⚡ FINISH — Focus closes the round.
rituals.POWER-UP 1: Before you begin Hold Sensation, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
rituals.POWER-UP 2: At Give Attention, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
rituals.POWER-UP 3: When you reach Focus, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.Win / Reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Focus with more choice than you had at Hold Sensation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I noticed the thought without becoming the thought.”
rituals.Formula Flow: Hold Sensation → Give Attention → Focus
rituals.Safety:
PAUSE
Stop equalisation when one signal requires urgent priority.
